method: Measured on 2026-10-30 by pnpm perf:budgets --bytes --template astro: the Astro template built for production (astro build) and served by astro preview against a seeded API; each script request Lighthouse's mobile load of / makes is fetched again, and scriptBytes is the sum of gzip(body) at zlib's default level. astro preview does not compress, so the wire size is the raw size. 48 B over 75989c8 (27,224 B), all in the client chunk every page shares: the guest order link (client.orders.requestLink), the email header sent beside an expired order key, and the stub for an adapter without guest orders. No script on / changed.
